src.label: Australian Department of Agriculture (Micor) — Lebanon, dogs (contact for the Directorate of Animal Resources)

head: No published rule set: Lebanon's Directorate of Animal Resources decides the import process.
lines: The Australian agriculture department does not list Lebanon's pet requirements; it says health requirements are those set by Lebanon and directs exporters to the Directorate of Animal Resources at info@agriculture.gov.lb.
Any import permit the directorate issues sets the conditions your pet must meet, so ask for it before booking the flight.
The Australian entry was last reviewed in July 2021, so treat it as a contact route, not a rulebook.
